hypothesis: Doubling depth at the same width (4 -> 8 layers, 29M -> 41M) lifts f0 test llm AP out of BERT-small's seed band 89.41-89.66 and reaches >= 91.0 (BERT-base 91.60): the residual gap is depth/capacity, since selection metric, eval grid, LR and seed are exhausted. A result inside the band means capacity between 29M and 41M does not matter and only the 110M BERT-base (or its 12 layers / 768 width) carries the last 2 points.
